description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearConfig, which provides a method for clearing configuration variables within the Smarty templating engine. It includes a method clearConfig() that can reset all or specific configuration variables in a Smarty_Internal_Data object.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearConfig
classes.description: Provides a method to clear configuration variables in Smarty templates.

methods.name: clearConfig
methods.description: Clears a specific configuration variable or all config variables in the provided Smarty_Internal_Data object.
